claims.claim: WCAG 2.1 Level AA requires normal text contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
claims.raw_snippet: The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

claims.claim: WCAG 2.1 Level AA requires large text contrast ratio of at least 3:1
claims.raw_snippet: Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1

claims.claim: CSS filter on an ancestor changes the containing block of a position:fixed element, so the fixed element is positioned relative to that ancestor instead of the viewport
claims.raw_snippet: unless any ancestor has transform , perspective , or filter property set to something other than none

claims.claim: The default human language of the page must be programmatically determinable, which is what the html lang attribute provides (WCAG 2.1 SC 3.1.1)
claims.raw_snippet: The default human language of each web page can be programmatically determined

claims.claim: All interactive elements must be operable by keyboard per WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 2.1.1
claims.raw_snippet: All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes

claims.claim: Purely decorative non-text content must be implemented so assistive technology can ignore it (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.1.1)
claims.raw_snippet: is used only for visual formatting, or is not presented to users, then it is implemented in a way that it can be ignored by assistive technology

claims.claim: localStorage persists data across browser sessions, so it can hold user accessibility preferences
claims.raw_snippet: the stored data is saved across browser sessions

claims.claim: Reference: the WCAG 2.1 specification is published by W3C at https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/
claims.raw_snippet: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 covers a wide range of recommendations for making web content more accessible.

claims.claim: Reference: W3C WAI publishes a customizable quick reference of WCAG success criteria and techniques
claims.raw_snippet: A customizable quick reference to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2 requirements (success criteria) and techniques.

claims.claim: Reference: W3C WAI publishes informative Understanding documents that explain each WCAG 2.1 success criterion
claims.raw_snippet: Understanding documents provide detailed explanations for Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) guidelines and success criteria.

claims.claim: Reference: the CSS Filter Effects specification states that filter creates a stacking context the same way opacity does
claims.raw_snippet: the same way that CSS opacity does. All the elements descendants are rendered together as a group with the filter effect applied to the group as a whole.

claims.claim: Reference: MDN's stacking context page lists filter (with a value other than none) among the properties that create a stacking context
claims.raw_snippet: Stacking context is a three-dimensional conceptualization of HTML elements along an imaginary z-axis relative to the user

claims.claim: Reference: WAVE (WebAIM) is a suite of web accessibility evaluation tools
claims.raw_snippet: is a suite of evaluation tools that helps authors make their web content more accessible to individuals with dis

claims.claim: Reference: Deque's axe DevTools provides automated accessibility testing for web and mobile
claims.raw_snippet: Automated accessibility testing for web and mobile

claims.claim: Reference: the Colour Contrast Analyser (CCA) is a free color contrast checker for WCAG color checking
claims.raw_snippet: One color contrast tool for all your WCAG color checking needs

claims.claim: Reference: NV Access develops the NVDA screen reader for blind and vision impaired computer users
claims.raw_snippet: We believe that every Blind + Vision Impaired person Deserves the right to freely & easily access a computer!

claims.claim: Regulation 35 defines the web accessibility standard as Israeli Standard 5568. (תקנה 35)
claims.raw_snippet: תקן ישראלי 5568 – קווים מנחים לנגישות תכנים באינטרנט

claims.claim: Regulation 35א(א) requires web services to meet the standard at level AA.
claims.raw_snippet: בהתאם לקווים המנחים הקבועים בו, ברמה AA

claims.claim: A document such as a PDF prepared from 26 October 2017 and uploaded to the site must be accessible (35א(ג)).
claims.raw_snippet: מסמך שהוכן מיום ו׳ בחשוון התשע״ח (26 באוקטובר 2017) ואילך, כגון מסמך pdf

claims.claim: A deviation is not a breach unless notice was sent and not fixed within a reasonable time, no later than 60 days (35א(ד)).
claims.raw_snippet: לא יאוחר מ־60 ימים מיום קבלת ההודעה

claims.claim: Captions (SC 1.2.2) for prerecorded video apply to public authorities and to businesses with average turnover above 5 million NIS that edit or produce recorded video (35ד).
claims.raw_snippet: חייב שהמחזור הממוצע שלו עולה על 5 מיליון שקלים העורך או מפיק תוכני וידיאו מוקלטים

claims.claim: The captions requirement is SC 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded).
claims.raw_snippet: בסעיף 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded)

claims.claim: An osek patur or a business with average annual turnover not exceeding 100,000 NIS is exempt from the web accessibility chapter (35ו(ז)).
claims.raw_snippet: שהמחזור השנתי הממוצע שלו אינו עולה על 100,000 שקלים חדשים, יהיה פטור

claims.claim: A holder of a 35ו exemption must provide alternative accessibility and publish the exemption and alternatives in the accessibility statement (35ו(ג)).
claims.raw_snippet: יספק נגישות חלופית ויפרסם בהצהרת הנגישות

claims.claim: Regulation 35ה requires an accessibility statement in a prominent place on the site and in any app.
claims.raw_snippet: חייב יציין במקום בולט באתר האינטרנט שלו

claims.claim: The statement includes the adaptations made, the coordinator's details if one must be appointed, and contact details for reporting a missing adaptation or requesting one.
claims.raw_snippet: ופרטים המאפשרים יצירת קשר לצורך הודעה על העדר התאמות נגישות

claims.claim: The coordinator's details are required only if the owner is obliged to appoint one.
claims.raw_snippet: אם מחויב למנותו

claims.claim: A public-service provider employing at least 25 employees must appoint an accessibility coordinator (s.19מב). (סעיף 19מב)
claims.raw_snippet: המעסיק 25 עובדים לפחות ימנה מקרב עובדיו

claims.claim: A court may award up to 50,000 NIS without proof of damage for a breach of the accessibility provisions (s.19נא(ב)). (סעיף 19נא)
claims.raw_snippet: פיצויים בסכום שלא יעלה על 50,000 שקלים חדשים, בלא הוכחת נזק

claims.claim: The 50,000 NIS amount is updated annually by the consumer price index.
claims.raw_snippet: יעודכן אחת לשנה בהתאם לשיעור עליית המדד
